title: Link tracker
info:
Track when users click on your links.

Generates a trackable link for any URL which can be shared. Whenever anyone uses the shared link this is recorded and reported in a stylish dashboard.

title: Heartwarm News
info: An application that searched popular new sites, extracted the happier stories, and published links to them.

title: Drag and Drop Website Editor
subtitle: Website builder
info: Drag and drop editor for HTML webpages. Designed to work with Brisk Content Management System

title: HTML Canvas Graph Animated Backround
info: Built as a fun test project for the HTML canvas, this project has since been used across multiple websites.

title: XSS Exploit Test Environment
info: Built for teaching year twelves, this simple project provides an interactive demonstration of how cross-site scripting attack works.

title: FindIt Home Inventory System
info:
Home inventory management system, complete with QR code printing and scanning.

Link to PocketBase backend code: https://github.com/Littled2/home-storage-backend

title: Headless Content Management System
info: Simple and robust open-source CMS, complete with client side routing. Perfect for fast, static websites.

title: Teleparty Link Share
info: Chrome Extension designed to work in tandem with the Teleparty/Netflix Party extension. Lets users share the join links that are generated.

title: AJAX in HTML (html-ajax)
info: A front-end library that allows your HTML to GET and POST data to your server, all with ZERO JavaScript. Completley backend agnostic.

title: Brisk Content Management System
info: Developed for use in websites I build for clients, Brisk CMS works as a bridge between a very light CMS that requires technical expertiese, and a more heavy-weight CMS. Perfect for the small businesses that use it.

title: Robo Trader
info: Node JS backend that monitored the prices of cryptocurrencies and searched for trends. Could place 'paper' trades to mimic trading. Built a React JS front end to monitor the system.
